title: Spotify Technology S.A. 2025 Form 20-F
excerpt: Spotify reported 2025 free cash flow of EUR 2.874 billion and year-end cash and short-term investments of EUR 9.467 billion. Its ordinary shares trade as SPOT on the New York Stock Exchange.
summary: Audited annual filing for the year ended 2025-12-31. It establishes the Luxembourg issuer and NYSE-listed ordinary-share identity, the subscription and advertising model, 751 million MAUs, 290 million Premium subscribers, EUR 2.874 billion of free cash flow, EUR 9.467 billion of cash and short-term investments, and material risks including competition, content-licensor concentration, advertising execution, regulation, privacy, AI, foreign exchange, and founder voting control.
